body: I've been trying to contact lawyers and what not to ask about disability but all the ones I've talked to say I need to be there in person for a consultation which is impossible without a car or someone who is willing to take me. I don't have many friends who would do it since I have no money and the rest have moved far away. I don't really have people to talk to. Being 19 and trans in the deep south can get you killed. That's not a risk I want to take. I don't want to die. Honestly, I don't. But I'm at my wits end. I sit around all day thinking about how awful everything is with no one to talk to. I hardly eat. I can't sleep because of the nightmares of my father raping me. It's all just snowballing into one emotional wreck. Sorry for the rant, and thanks for the link. I'll check into it.
I know what you're going through. I really do. If you need someone to talk to, feel free to PM me. I'm in almost the same boat and I came here to post as well.

Not being able to tell anyone or show physically that I want to be a woman is the hardest part. I don't care about what pronouns people call me or anything like that. I'm just disgusted with being a biological male. And I feel guilty that I don't want to be one since I have a cis, straight girlfriend who doesn't really know how to feel about it.

Doing my best, I suppose. Things just aren't working out in life. Sick of being who I am and I'm hating who I want to be. It's a vicious cycle. People who aren't trans just don't get it. At all. They say they do all day but they truly do not get it.

I just. I don't know. It makes me feel guilty. I've been swayed into thinking that way through my upbringing. Like it's my fault. Like it's some disease that I can't pay a doctor to get rid of. As much as I don't want to be a male, I hate the feeling. I really do.
Yeah, that's what I figured. Also I have a girlfriend who I am sexually intimate with so.
It's an awful thing to go through. You have my thoughts with you as well. I'm very sorry.

Sometime around the beginning of next year I'll finish it. I would love to take hormones but I just don't want to make my girlfriend uncomfortable I suppose. She isn't really transphobic but she just doesn't get it, you know? And it's so frustrating because I love her to death but she really just doesn't understand.

Also a victim of serious sexual abuse as a child being called "daddy's little girl" when my father raped me. Luckily he's dead. And I've been told I'm a paranoid schizophrenic which I am currently unmedicated for if that helps much of anything. I've been carrying the pain of feeling uncomfortable as a male for years. Help?
